query: SELECT p.id FROM products p WHERE p.tenant=$1 AND p.id=ANY($2) AND p.active AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM products parent WHERE parent.tenant=p.tenant AND parent.id=p.parent_id AND parent.active)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_channel_visibility v WHERE v.tenant=p.tenant AND v.channel_id=$3 AND NOT v.visible AND (v.product_id=p.id OR v.product_id=p.parent_id))
